sources.title: Qwen - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Alibaba launched a beta of Qwen in April 2023 under the name Tongyi Qianwen, then opened it for public use in September 2023 after regulatory clearance. [1][2] The model's architecture was based on the Llama architecture developed by Meta AI. [3][4] In December 2023, it released its 72B and 1.8B models for download, while Qwen 7B weights were released in August. [5][6]
